title: 第13章 百脉来贺第14章 当众挑战
slug: 真心待你反被弃转娶圣女你悔啥
lines: read2（）;在万众瞩目下，林家一行三人，走入了紫阳峰。
林轻眉和林子衿站在身后，为首的是一名不怒自威的中年男子。
林天雄，林家一脉的家主，也是林轻眉和林子衿的亲生父亲。
他身穿锦袍，迈着四方步，气度不凡，威严深重，就像是一头雄狮，令人不敢对视。
然而谁都知道，林天雄看似刚正不阿，实际上却是个赌鬼。
他好赌成瘾，无论是牌九麻将骰子，还是口头对赌，他都来者不拒。
而他什么都赌，上至林家一脉的矿脉和药田，下至一壶灵酒，一颗灵果，他都照赌不误。
但他的赌术却是奇差无比，基本上十赌九输。
曾经的林家一脉，在一百零八脉中排名中等，拥有好几座矿脉和药田。
但这些年却是被他败光，输了个一干二净。
甚至这三年，若不是辰南替他还赌债，恐怕玉灵峰都要被他输了去。
“贤婿，恭喜你重开辰家一脉，我相信你一定能够重振雄风，成为第二个天辰圣人！”
林天雄满脸堆笑，快步走到辰南身前，一副翁婿和睦的姿态。
这让旁边想要看热闹的众人一脸懵逼。
辰南和林轻眉不是和离了吗？
据说辰南连彩礼都要回去了。
怎么林天雄还把辰南将做女婿看待？
别说众人了，便是辰南都微微一愣，不明所以。
“我与林轻眉已经和离！”
辰南开口，受不了林天雄这么热情。
“你虽然和轻眉因感情不和而分开，但在我眼里，你一直都是我的贤婿。”
“一日为婿，众生为婿，不管其他人如何看，我反正就认准你一人！”
林天雄此话一出，众人惊叹。
然而辰南却是眼睛微眯，猜到了林天雄的心思。
这三年自己掏心掏肺，给林家补贴了不少灵石和宝物。
林天雄的赌债，也全都是辰南补上的。
他怎么可能放弃这棵摇钱树。
况且辰南孤身一人，实力低微，是最好拿捏的对象。
不像萧天麟，他不仅自身天赋异禀，背后更有一个强大的萧家一脉。
林天雄虽然好赌成瘾，但却不是傻子。
若是投靠萧家一脉，恐怕整个林家都要被吃干抹净。
不得不说，林天雄好的一手好算盘。
可惜辰南已经幡然醒悟，又岂会当这个冤大头。

read2(); Under the gaze of everyone, the three members of the Lin family walked into Ziyang Peak.
Lin Qingmei and Lin Zijin stood behind them, led by a middle-aged man who was not angry and proud.
Lin Tianxiong, the head of the Lin family, is also the biological father of Lin Qingmei and Lin Zijin.
Wearing a brocade robe, he walked in a square step, with extraordinary bearing and majesty, like a lion, which made people dare not look at him.
However, everyone knows that Lin Tianxiong seems to be upright, but in fact he is a gambler.
He is addicted to gambling, whether it is Pai Gow, mahjong, dice, or oral gambling, he will not refuse anything.
And he would bet on everything, from the mineral veins and medicinal fields of the Lin family to a pot of spiritual wine or a spiritual fruit, he would bet on everything.
But his gambling skills were extremely poor, and he basically lost nine out of ten bets.
The Lin family's lineage once ranked in the middle among the one hundred and eight lines, and owned several mineral veins and medicinal fields.
But in these years, he has been completely defeated by him, and he has lost everything.
Even in the past three years, if Chen Nan hadn't paid off his gambling debts for him, he would have lost Yuling Peak.
"Xian son-in-law, congratulations on re-opening the Chen family lineage. I believe you will be able to regain your glory and become the second Tianchen Saint!"
With a smile on his face, Lin Tianxiong walked quickly to Chen Nan, as if he were a father-in-law and his son-in-law.
This made everyone nearby who wanted to watch the fun look confused.
Didn’t Chen Nan and Lin Qingmei reconcile?
It is said that Chen Nan even wants to go back with the bride price.
Why does Lin Tianxiong still regard General Chen Nan as his son-in-law?
Not to mention everyone, even Chen Nan was slightly stunned, not knowing why.
"Lin Qingmei and I have reconciled!"
Chen Nan spoke, unable to stand Lin Tianxiong's enthusiasm.
"Although you and Qingmei separated due to emotional discord, in my eyes, you have always been my virtuous son-in-law."
"One day is my son-in-law, and all living beings are my son-in-law. No matter what other people think, I will always choose you!"
As soon as Lin Tianxiong said these words, everyone was amazed.
However, Chen Nan narrowed his eyes slightly and guessed Lin Tianxiong's thoughts.
In the past three years, I have poured out my heart and soul and subsidized a lot of spiritual stones and treasures to the Lin family.
Lin Tianxiong's gambling debts were all paid by Chen Nan.
How could he give up this money tree.
Moreover, Chen Nan is alone and has low strength, so he is the best target.
Unlike Xiao Tianlin, he is not only gifted, but also has a powerful Xiao family lineage behind him.
Although Lin Tianxiong is addicted to gambling, he is not a fool.
If he joins the Xiao family, I'm afraid the entire Lin family will be wiped out.
I have to say that Lin Tianxiong has good calculation skills.
It's a pity that Chen Nan has come to his senses and will not be taken advantage of.
